name: dsh-web-search-tavily
description: DSH web search provider backed by Tavily (https://tavily.com): registers ctx.web search providers under the id `tavily` (alias `dsh-web-search-tavily`) and calls POST {base}/search with a Bearer API key, mapping results[] to normalized, citeable sources plus Tavily's optional LLM answer as content. Includes an in-flight query coalescer and a client-side throttle (concurrency cap, minimum request spacing, 429 cool-down with bounded backoff) sized for Tavily's rate-plan limits.
